goal: Transform messenger layout and styling to Telegram+Discord hybrid aesthetic
summary: Transformed messenger UI to a Telegram+Discord hybrid aesthetic across all 5 steps: (1) Layout redesigned with minimal 48px rail and tighter gaps, (2) Conversations panel restyled as Telegram flat list with bottom dividers and left accent bars, (3) Messages converted to Discord-style flat list with sender avatar and nickname added via minimal JSX changes, (4) Composer, header, friends view, and tabs flattened with subtle borders instead of pills/panels, (5) Build passes with zero errors. Zero gradients remain in messenger/message selectors. Both light and dark themes are preserved via CSS variables.
stepSummaries:
1. Redesign layout: narrow rail (~44px, no bg), widen conversations panel for Telegram-style chat list, adjust chat panel proportions [verified]
  2. Style conversations panel like Telegram: flat list items, subtle dividers between chats, preview text styling, remove rounded card backgrounds [verified]
  3. Add sender avatar/nickname to message JSX in MessengerWindow.tsx, then style messages as Discord flat list (no bubble bg/radius, avatar+name+text+timestamp layout) [verified]
  4. Style composer, chat header, and friends view to match clean Discord/Telegram aesthetic [verified]
  5. Build client workspace to confirm no TypeScript or Vite errors [verified]
